svg.title: Mermaid 架构图：06-skill-runtime
svg.desc: 基于当前 Python 实现的 Skevo 系统设计图。
svg.title: Skill 发现、检索、调用与执行
svg.desc: 自上而下展示 Skill 首次发现与缓存、主 Agent 的自动 BM25 检索和 REPL 显式调用两条入口，以及真正调用后的 inline 或 fork 执行；检索摘要只帮助模型判断，不会自动激活 Skill

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: B · 两类入口：retrieval 不等于 invocation

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: A · 发现、解析与进程内缓存

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: fork · Skill 特有边界；通用子 Agent 生命周期见图 09

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: B1 · 主 Agent 自动检索

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: cache = None；下次 discover 调用重扫

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
💾 Skill 根目录
用户级 ~/.skevo/skills 先加载
项目级 .skevo/skills 后加载

div.style: color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
首次 discover：扫描目录型 SKILL.md
frontmatter + 正文 → SkillDefinition
解析失败静默忽略；用户级同名优先
结果写入进程内 cache，后续复用

div.style: color: rgb(18, 61, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
重启，或 create / evolve / prune
成功后显式 reset

div.style: color: rgb(59, 42, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
👤 普通用户请求
仅主 Agent 执行 retrieval

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
tokenize：ASCII / 中文词元与 bigram，过滤 stop tokens
BM25：metadata ×3 + body 前 2500 chars
score ≥ 0.08；最多 top 3

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
摘要 name / score / source / description / when-to-use
追加 <retrieved_skills> 到本轮 user message

div.style: color: rgb(7, 59, 76) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
◇ 模型是否调用 skill tool?
tool 路径不检查 user_invocable

div.style: color: rgb(59, 42, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(58, 38, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
否：按普通文本进入 Agent.chat
不返回 Unknown；随后执行 B1 retrieval

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
fork：调用当前 Agent.chat
先执行 B1 retrieval，再请求模型调用 skill tool
模型仍可能不调用

div.style: color: rgb(58, 38, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 没有 Skill invocation；继续普通 Agent Loop

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 模型发出公共 skill tool call

div.style: color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
execute_skill
同步按 name 查找
Skill 存在？

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(74, 41, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
inline / skill tool：activated + 完整 Prompt
作为 tool result 回当前循环

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
inline / REPL direct：以完整 Prompt 开新 chat
仍执行主 Agent retrieval

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
选择父 Agent 当前工具
allowed_tools 为真：按 name 过滤
未配置或 []：继承但移除 agent

div.style: color: rgb(50, 24, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
新 Agent：base system = Skill Prompt；新 history；is_sub_agent
父为 plan：追加自己的 Plan prompt + 专属 plan path
否则 bypassPermissions

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
run_once(args 或默认任务)
无 retrieval / MCP lazy init / usage tracking / Session auto-save

div.style: color: rgb(50, 24, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
成功：返回文本或 no output
token 增量计入父 Agent

div.style: color: rgb(90, 11, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
❌ run_once 异常 → Skill fork error
异常前子 Agent 已消耗 token 当前不回计父 Agent

div.style: color: rgb(58, 38, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⚠ 工具边界：过滤为空会因 custom_tools or defaults 回退默认 tools；
父 MCP schema 即使入选，子 Agent 也没有对应连接

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 92) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

svg.text: Skill 发现、检索、调用与执行
